project.name: Decision Engine :: API Specifications
project.description:
Canonical, SINGLE-COPY interface-definition sources for this service, one directory per wire protocol under META-INF - mirrors agent-os-api-specifications' own META-INF/openapi convention in forwardmeasure-agent-os exactly (a plain resources jar, unpacked by each language-binding module rather than the source files being copied into them - see decision-engine-api-language-bindings' own module Javadoc for why that distinction matters).
Currently: META-INF/proto/forwardmeasure/decisionengine/v1/{evaluation,ruleset_management}.proto (gRPC/Protocol Buffers).
Deliberately structured to add a Thrift interface later as a sibling, e.g. META-INF/thrift/forwardmeasure/decisionengine/v1/*.thrift, without restructuring this module or anything that depends on it - do not flatten "proto" out of the resource path into something protocol-agnostic; the whole point is that multiple protocol directories can coexist here side by side once there is a second one.
